Q4 FY2026 8,350 = Q3 7,318 x 1.14 (CFO: 'mid-teens percent sequentially', src 17), after the ~$300M Fab 28 hit that is almost all 10nm server (CFO, src 17). FY2027 36,700 (+36%): H1 capped (CFO: 'still constrained on Intel 3'; market share 'a function of supply', src 17): Q1 8,200 (Fab 28 recovery), Q2 8,700. H2 is where capacity lands: +40% substrate capacity, 'a lot of that' in the back half (CFO), and Oregon Intel 3 for Xeon in production in H2 2027 (CEO, src 17): Q3 9,500, Q4 10,300, i.e. the Q4 exit is +18% on Q2, less than the +40% substrate add because wafers (Intel 3) and materials (Unimicron: 20% substrate material gap in 2027, src 18) still bind.
